description: TIGER and H2-TIGER are linear optimisation models of Europe’s gas and hydrogen systems. TIGER represents operation of gas infrastructure; H2-TIGER adds hydrogen networks, investment and repurposing decisions. The provider is EWI, University of Cologne. Coverage: Coverage is European transmission pipelines, storage and import terminals, with hydrogen-ramp-up scenarios through 2050. Exact network and time resolution are not quantified on the reviewed excerpt. Access: EWI describes model-based research and consulting. No public code or model download was established, and no service was requested. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: These are provider-operated analytical models. Access, costs and the detailed mathematical assumptions require agreement with EWI. For simulation they support supply-disruption, infrastructure-investment and regulatory scenarios. Related resources: data-scigrid-gas is a separate European network-data family; the reviewed page does not establish that TIGER uses it.
